mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals labor market weakness that may prompt central bank intervention, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days as investors anticipate economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in labor force participation (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as market sentiment deteriorates.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (PAYEMS and HOUST both declining) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-pandemic recovery regime, a quarterly GDP level above 16000 billion of chained 2017 dollars signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during the post-pandemic recovery when GDPC1 > 16000, or the Rank IC for GDPC1 in this regime is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days as real rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 2.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In an ultra-low interest rate environment (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive returns over the next 60 days as the central bank maintains accommodative policy to support economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of persistently low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals a policy response to economic distress, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days as market uncertainty rises.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS < 0.25% and UNRATE > 5.0%) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.
